title: On the Complexity Gap Between POMDPs and Multi-Environment POMDPs
abstract: arXiv:2610.15010v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-environment POMDPs (ME-POMDPs) generalize POMDPs by encoding a finite set of possible environments, capturing model uncertainty. The finite-horizon robust reward maximization problem for a ME-POMDP asks for a policy that maximizes reward in the worst environment, and recent work has shown this problem to be $\mathsf{PSPACE}$-complete. We expand the complexity landscape of ME-POMDPs by identifying which subclasses retain this $\mathsf{PSPACE}$-completeness. In particular, we take subclasses of POMDPs that are tractable in the single-environment case, and investigate the computational complexity of these classes when extended to the multi-environment setting. We first prove the $\mathsf{NP}$-completeness of multi-environment blind MDPs and deterministic POMDPs using a certain closure-under-mixture condition. translated_title: 关于POMDP与多环境POMDP之间复杂性差距的研究
translated_abstract: 多环境POMDP（ME-POMDP）通过编码一组有限的可能环境来推广POMDP，从而刻画模型的不确定性。ME-POMDP的有限时域鲁棒奖励最大化问题要求找到一个在最坏环境中也能最大化奖励的策略，近期的研究表明该问题是PSPACE完全的。我们通过确定哪些子类仍保持这种PSPACE完全性，扩展了ME-POMDP的复杂性图景。特别地，我们选取在单环境情形下计算上易于处理的POMDP子类，并研究这些子类在扩展到多环境设置时的计算复杂性。我们首先利用一种混合封闭条件证明了多环境盲MDP和确定性POMDP的NP完全性；随后我们证明，对于一系列不满足该封闭条件的子类，其问题仍为PSPACE完全的，由此得到了新的……
tldr: 本文系统刻画了多环境POMDP的计算复杂性图景，表明在单环境中易于求解的POMDP子类扩展到多环境后，满足混合封闭条件的（如盲MDP、确定性POMDP）变为NP完全，而不满足该条件的子类仍保持PSPACE完全性。
en_tdlr: This paper maps the complexity landscape of multi-environment POMDPs, showing that POMDP subclasses tractable in the single-environment case become NP-complete under a closure-under-mixture condition (e.g., blind MDPs and deterministic POMDPs), while other subclasses remain PSPACE-complete.
